title: analysis.address.resolve result
description: Every reading of the value, each expressed in the frames it reaches.

frames.description: One number in every frame that reading reaches. A frame is absent when the reading has none — a value below the mapped origin is not a hunk offset, and no reading has a whole-file position without an anchor.

hunk_file_offset.description: Where the anchoring hunk's bytes start in the file.

hunk_bytes.description: How many bytes the anchoring hunk holds, so a caller can tell a reading that lands inside it from one that lands just past the end.

as_whole_file.description: Present only when a hunk anchors the frame.
